notes.title: Binaural sound in 8874.
notes.notes:
[i]Put your headphones on, and submerge yourself into the world...[/i]

Lately, we've been working on the audio side of the 8874 so it can catch up to its gorgeous visuals. To provide that we introduced [b]binaural sound sources.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/6521e89daf8cf9506b0c7b6d11dc3be30b5315d6.png[/img]

It will make the in-game sound feel more immersive and provide a bit of the ASMR experience when playing with headphones on.  

[i][b]ASMR[/b] - the subjective experience of "low-grade euphoria" characterized by "a combination of positive feelings and a distinct static-like tingling sensation on the skin". It is most commonly triggered by specific auditory stimulation. [/i]

Binaural audio technically refers to audio captured in a way that a person would hear the sound exactly as they would in the real world.
Binaural sound is kind of similar to a stereo sound, but it "feels" way more alife compared to more "flat" stereo sound. 

You can hear the difference by yourself here (remember to put your headphones on!): 
[previewyoutube=jIwad_L9neM;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/139845ae2c95d36eb6cb223ca5f5a02d1cba0318.png[/img]
[b]One of the first game locations with the new sound sources set up.[/b]

We hope that the addition of the binaural sound sources will bring the in-game immersion to the next level, 
[i]see you soon...[/i]

notes.title: After the Demo.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/bc0607e04e844488d963fda674312d8af9e5b2d1.png[/img]

[h3]All good things must come to an end, 
so does Steam Next Fest and 8874 Demo.[/h3]

[b]We looked through the feedback and thanks to you guys we know what to improve/change: [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Double jump[/b] - the most disliked mechanic is going back to the sketch board. 
We thought of making the height and the length of the jump dependent on the momentum, or the length of the jump key press. 
[*] [b]Wiktor's Home[/b]- we'll think about cutting the animation time after death, additionally, some things will be added there, to diversify the experience. At home, you'll be able to see various items collected during your adventure too. 
[*] [b]Running [/b]- we'll think about lowering character speed a bit and adding a dedicated run button (will help to solve the double jump problem)
[*] [b]Jumping sound[/b] - the distracting sound will be changed 
[/list]
Of course, we'll be adding a lot of new content before release, as well as doing loads of bug fixing.

Right now it's time to get back to work,
[i]till the next time...[/i]

notes.title: Legends and inspirations.
notes.notes:
[i]Come closer to the fire and listen.
Let us tell you a few stories that inspired us to create 8874 world and its story...[/i]

[b]The Golden Train[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/1773f2bb982210d6cc2549aaa3707ae9e508b9b2.jpg[/img]

After WWII, the legend of the Golden Trainer ran around the world, stimulating people's imagination and greed. Is that legend only a story for the children? One day, maybe we'll find out!

At the end of the war, German soldiers were trying to move all the riches looted while occupying most of Europe. For decades, many groups of discoverers and treasure hunters tried to find it between the city of Wrocław and Wałbrzych but without any outcome. 

Maybe you'll have more luck during your journey through the forgotten tunnels...

[b]The White Lady[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/b26762b96672c0e9f927f2c9daed55b55159ab4a.jpg[/img]

Every castle in the world got its secrets Książ Castle is no different. 
There are a lot of stories about paranormal activities inside its halls.
 
One of the most famous is the legend about the White Lady, who haunts the manor and its surroundings. She appears during the lightning storms in the wedding dress and a veil. 

People say that there once was a girl who was foretold death during her wedding. Her parents forbid her to marry the man she loved for a long time, but after years of her crave they gave up. The ceremony took place inside the castle, and only the closest family was invited to ensure safety. 
However, the prophesy had to be fulfilled... 

As soon as the wedding began, the terrible storm broke loose. It lasted for three days and three nights trapping everyone inside the castle. Ultimately the unfortunate bride ran outside, yelling at the heavens to take their toll. Immediately, she got struck by the lightning. The storm stopped along with her heart. 
Some people describe her ghost as harmless, while some swear that she is a sinister being. 

You'll be able to form your own opinion after playing 8874...

[b]The Giants Grave[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/f11dc65bdab2f9dec984385c23a31a53945910fd.jpg[/img]

People surely like love stories. 
Here is another legend with affection in the background. 

In forgotten times, when giants roamed the earth, one of the specimens fell in love. Knowing his feelings are going to be rejected, he decided to take matters into his hands, kidnapped the younger sister of the local forester, and took her to his cave to make her his wife.
 
Cunning and persistent forester didn’t want to abandon his sister. For the whole day and night, he was nagging the kidnapper. When the time came, the young sister managed to escape from the grasps of the oppressor and fled to her beloved brother. Brave forester took the advantage of the giants mourn and collapsed the only entrance of the cave. 

To this day, allegedly, people are hearing voices coming from the mountain named after the brokenhearted fairy giant.


[i]That's all for now, 
till we meet again...[/i]

notes.title: 8874 between worlds.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/02dad8868a79a7724223aa0504205a5d66bc4da2.jpg[/img]

[b]The most beautiful world is always entered through imagination.
However, the imagination can be fueled by real things and places. [/b]

The most thrilling and beautiful places of Wałbrzych city were transferred to the game thanks to photogrammetry technology. A system that allows you to scan buildings, areas, lengths, placement of objects and shapes from the photos and implement them as models in games. Something like motion capture but for still objects and buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/52948537bb5d67da2c95407ebb5a5713d309ccea.jpg[/img]

Originally, photogrammetry was used by cartographers, surveyors, and even in medicine. [b]<THE MORE YOU KNOW>[/b] Now it's our time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/d4273bcb5abe759909cf127a8d00949e535d6204.jpg[/img]

In 8874 we used photogrammetry, to reflect the beauty of Wałbrzych, an old mining town, and the surrounding areas of Dolny Slask in Poland. Creating the most immersive experience for those [b]who are looking deeper than just the first plan...[/b]
